critical_audit_findings: Original claimed 64.6% win rate FAILED audit due to lookahead bias (if hit_tp evaluated before hit_sl) and microscopic 2-4 pt stops on NQ cash open.
23 out of 29 losses were stopped out in the first 5 minutes due to placing stops too close to the cash open noise.
The 6 legitimate WIN trades all had realistic structural stops between 20.0 and 53.5 points.
Rule Revision: Stop loss MUST be anchored to the 09:30 cash open swing low/high (20-40 pts buffer), NOT pre-market 08:30 noise.
